description: How the app shows a format: on its entry, a column’s `show_as`, `header` line, `hidden`, `new_entry` and the `order`; a board’s lanes; a table column’s `width`; a column’s `setting` in a list, a roadmap, a ready list or a start-here question; `view: saved`, a `name` and what it keeps (`today` stays that phrase) — on one saved, only what is given changes; `match:{}`, `search:""`, `order:""`, `columns:{}` empty one — or `rename`, or `delete: true`; `view: dashboard` `add`s, `size`s, `order`s and `remove`s blocks (no `format`: the document’s). `formats` with a `format` shows the arrangement and each column’s ways. Dry-runs until `commit: true`.

commit.description: Write it; omit for the dry run.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

add.description: dashboard: `{saved}`, `{rollup}` or `{total, count|sum, match}`, with `format` on the document’s.

column.description: On a board, the enum for lanes; omit for its first.

header.description: entry: in the line under the title.

hidden.description: entry: kept off the page, still in the table and every tool.

kind.description: saved: the view it opens as; defaults to table.

new_entry.description: entry: a new entry asks for it.

order.description: entry, alone: these columns first; [] resets. saved: the column it sorts by. dashboard: blocks’ names.

setting.description: list: group, line, done <members>, together (`group line`); roadmap: order, under, line; ready: waits, ready <members> done <members>, line; start: is <member>, latest <n>, line; agenda: date, done <members>, line. null clears.

show_as.description: entry: a way the column offers; null resets.

size.description: dashboard: `{name, width, height}` — columns 1–4, rows 2–20, either alone.

name: arrange_views
title: Arrange a format’s views
